HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Modern Nationalism in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Modern Nationalism in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Modern Nationalism in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Modern Nationalism in Africa.

2. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.
   B. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.

3. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence.
   C. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat National integration as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.
   C. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Global Wars is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Global Wars.

6. Which statement about African Civilisations up to 19th Century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations up to 19th Century.
   B. Say African Civilisations up to 19th Century never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat African Civilisations up to 19th Century as rumours only.

7. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

8. Which statement about Elections in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Elections in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Elections in Kenya.
   D. Treat Elections in Kenya as rumours only.

9. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Ignore prices in shops

10. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.
   B. Treat Introduction to History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   C. Say Introduction to History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Public Participation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Public Participation.
   B. Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Public Participation as rumours only.
   D. Say Public Participation never happens in Kenya.

12. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

13. Which statement about Linguistic groups in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Linguistic groups in Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Say Linguistic groups in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Linguistic groups in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Linguistic groups in Kenya.

14. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Colonization of Africa.
   C. Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Colonization of Africa as rumours only.

15. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   B. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.

16. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nairobi

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Public Participation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Elections in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain National integration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Human Developments in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
